item.title: AI data center copper demand forecasts may be overstated
item.description: Forecasts for copper demand from artificial intelligence (AI) data centers may be overly optimistic, as rising prices are curbing consumption and accelerating the substitution of copper with cheaper aluminium in some applications, analysts say.
